[CONTRIBUTION EVENT]
- Type: Time (Minutes)
- Amount: 60
- Description: Schwab Trader API registration + read-only portfolio integration status verification
  
  Pull requests (GitHub evidence):
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/sentiment_importer/pull/1138
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/sentiment_importer/pull/1139
  - https://github.com/TrueSightDAO/sentiment_importer/pull/1143
  
  Details:
  Registration of Charles Schwab developer account and submission of the "Trader API - Individual" access request, plus a full read-only deployment-state verification of the Schwab portfolio integration in sentiment_importer (Perch).
  
  WORK COMPLETED THIS SESSION
  1. Governance paperwork (Gary Teh, ~30 min): registered the Charles Schwab Developer account and submitted the Trader API - Individual access request. Portal confirms submission, status "Pending - Request Access", with Accounts and Trading Production + Market Data Production gated pending Enterprise Administrator review (quoted up to 2 business days).
  
  2. Diagnostic / verification (Sophia, ~30 min) — established ground truth on seni_ror rather than trusting the plan file:
     • Confirmed PR1 (Schwab brokerage adapter, #1138), PR2 (OAuth link/callback, #1139) and PR3 (read-only positions API + docs, #1143) are all MERGED on origin/master.
     • Confirmed they are NOT deployed: deployed HEAD on seni_ror is 43b505c9, which is 6 commits behind origin/master; app/controllers/schwab_link_controller.rb and app/models/brokerages/schwab.rb are absent from the deployed working tree.
     • Probed the live site: https://perch.truesight.me/schwab/connect, /schwab/callback and /api/positions all return 404.
     • Confirmed SCHWAB_CLIENT_ID / SCHWAB_CLIENT_SECRET are NOT set in the seni_ror systemd environment (only SECRET_KEY_BASE, RAILS_ENV, EDGAR_FULL_HOST present).
     • Confirmed serving topology: perch.truesight.me is nginx on seni_ror directly (Let's Encrypt CN=perch.truesight.me, A-record 54.211.179.126), NOT fronted by krake_nginx — so the callback URL to register with Schwab is https://perch.truesight.me/schwab/callback.
     • Verified the authorize URL is built from schwab_callback_url in schwab_link_controller, so any callback-URI mismatch will break the token exchange.
  
  DELIVERABLES
  • Definitive staged sequence for activation, recorded in the thread and in a calendar reminder set for 2026-11-11.
  • Surfaced the two stop-gates: (a) production deploy of the 6 pending commits requires explicit governor GO; (b) Schwab refresh tokens expire every 7 days (hard platform limit, no code workaround) — periodic re-linking via /schwab/connect is expected.
  
  NEXT (blocked on Schwab approval)
  Create app → register callback https://perch.truesight.me/schwab/callback → set env credentials on seni_ror → governor GO to deploy → end-to-end link at /schwab/connect and verify /api/positions returns live holdings (plan §4 acceptance test).
  
  SCOPE NOTE: read-only integration only. No order-placement path is enabled; the Schwab class deliberately inherits raise-NotImplementedError trading methods, enforced by spec.
- Contributor(s): Gary Teh, Sophia Truesight
- TDG Issued: 100.00
- Attached Filename: N/A
- Destination Contribution File Location: N/A
--------
